summary: Frontend-only verification of this turn's 2 App.tsx changes plus independent confirmation of the 'Feed Program Settings are localStorage-only' finding. (1) bbmFarmScopedCacheGuard VERIFIED: seeded all 13 guarded localStorage keys with DUMMY_FARM_A on /?farm=default&t=..., then navigated to /?farm=north-creek&t=... — all 13 keys were wiped, feedmate-active-farm-slug updated to 'north-creek', no console errors from the guard (only pre-existing 401s on /api/auth/me). (2) Header fallback VERIFIED: with cleared localStorage, farm 'default' header renders 'My Farm — Broiler Base Mate' (no literal 'Double B Farm'); the only remaining 'Double B Farm' strings in the served bundle are two input placeholders. (3) NEW FINDING CONFIRMED — Feed Program Settings (farmName/shedGroups/farmType/theme) are localStorage-ONLY: saving Farm Name 'TEST SYNC CHECK' produced ZERO POST/PATCH/PUT API requests (network captured); header updated locally; after localStorage.clear() + reload of the SAME farm URL the header reverted to 'My Farm' and the Settings Farm Name field was EMPTY, even though the server's farm_config doc for farm 'default' holds farmName='Double B Farm'. So a grower's QR link opened on a second device shows generic farm identity and their Settings do not follow them. Server DB was never touched by the test (verified farm_config.default still 'Double B Farm', 0 docs named TEST SYNC CHECK) so no restore was required. Regression: Archive tab (data-testid=tab-locked-batches-archive) renders 'Locked Batches Archive' with the closed batch + View Report/Resend Email, settings-upgrade-pay-now visible in the Settings drawer, anonymous QR /?farm=default&t=... loads the real app (not /landing).

ui_bugs.issue: The nudge container intercepts pointer events across the app while shown — Playwright normal clicks on the top tab bar ([data-testid=tab-locked-batches-archive]) and on the Settings drawer 'Save & Close' button both timed out with '<div> intercepts pointer events' until 'Skip tour' was clicked. A real user on desktop may be unable to hit controls under/over that overlay region.
Misleading badge: Farm Name (and Total Sheds / Batch Number / Default Silo Unit) are labelled 'Synced with Silo Base Mate' but saving writes to localStorage only — nothing is sent to the server.
Testability gap: Farm Name input, Total Sheds input and 'Save & Close' / 'Cancel' buttons have no data-testid (had to select by placeholder/text).

integration_issues.flow: Feed Program Settings persistence / cross-device farm identity
integration_issues.issue: CONFIRMED: saveFarmConfig() (App.tsx ~167) only does localStorage.setItem + a synthetic storage event — no fetch/PATCH. farmConfig state is initialised solely from readFarmConfig() (localStorage); the server value from GET /api/farm-config (farmName, which for 'default' is 'Double B Farm') is only used to auto-dismiss the first-login wizard (line ~9324) and to read logoData (line ~10317), never to hydrate farmName/shedGroups/farmType/theme. Net effect: farm identity, shed-group activation, farm type and theme are per-browser, not per-farm.
affected_selectors: header span 'My Farm — Broiler Base Mate'

integration_issues.issue: App.tsx lines 9324 and 10317 (and components/EndOfBatchContent.tsx:77) call fetch('/api/farm-config') with NO ?farm= param. Backend defaults farm=DEFAULT_FARM_ID ('default'), so for any non-default farm these calls read/authorise against the WRONG farm — observed 401s on north-creek (anon token) and, for an owner session, would return farm 'default's logo/config. Cross-farm read bug.

action_items: Persist Feed Program Settings server-side: PATCH /api/farm-config?farm=<slug> on saveFarmConfig (farmName, shedGroups/enabledGroupIds, farmType, theme) and hydrate farmConfig from GET /api/farm-config?farm=<slug> on mount (server wins when local cache is empty). Until then remove the 'Synced with Silo Base Mate' badges — they are false.
Add ?farm=<active slug> to every fetch('/api/farm-config') call (App.tsx 9324, 10317; EndOfBatchContent.tsx 77) — currently they always hit farm 'default'.
Fix OnboardingNudge overlay so it does not intercept pointer events outside its own card (pointer-events:none on the wrapper, pointer-events:auto on the card).
Add data-testid to Settings drawer farm-name input, total-sheds input and Save & Close / Cancel buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: saveFarmConfig() is the single write path for all farm identity/config and is localStorage-only — this is the root cause of the 'different device shows a different farm name' behaviour; it is a data-durability issue too (clearing browser data loses shed-group config).

The cache guard clears FARM_CONFIG_KEY on farm switch, which is correct for isolation but, combined with no server sync, means switching farms permanently destroys the previous farm's Settings on that browser.
App.tsx is ~12.7k lines — well past the 700-line guideline; extract farm-config, settings drawer and archive into modules.

rca_of_the_issue: readFarmConfig()/saveFarmConfig() (App.tsx 151-170) use only localStorage under key 'silo-farm-config'; the backend GET/PATCH /api/farm-config endpoints exist and already store farmName per farm, but the Feed Program never PATCHes them and never reads farmName from them. Therefore the same farm URL opened in a fresh browser/device falls back to the (now-corrected) 'My Farm' placeholder instead of the grower's real configured farm name.
